verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official MCP integration that lets Claude, Cursor or any other MCP-compatible client connect to Windmill and trigger scripts and flows, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page. The evidence is a single short docs excerpt, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: details on setup, auth and token scoping for the MCP endpoint, the exposed tool surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: With MCP, you can connect your favorite LLMs (like Claude, Cursor, or any MCP compatible client) to Windmill, allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat.
